sentences.en: We used to play over by that grassy knoll.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常常在那个草地上玩耍。

sentences.en: Twenty thousand years ago, humans lived in grassy tundras near the Arctic Circle.
sentences.zh: 二十万年前，人类生活在北极圈附近的草原苔原上。

sentences.en: Tom was on the grassy knoll with a rifle.
sentences.zh: 汤姆拿着步枪站在了草地上。
